title: Kimchi Bok Choi Deopbap
description: A traditional Korean rice bowl dish made with kimchi, bok choy, and gochujang. Quick and easy to make, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the Deopbap Rice according to the package instructions.
In a large pan, heat 1 tsp of sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped green onions and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the kimchi and gochujang to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the bok choy to the pan and stir-fry until wilted.
Combine the cooked rice with the kimchi mixture and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Transfer the rice bowl to individual plates and garnish with toasted sesame oil, sesame seeds, and chopped green onions.
